title: Portainer Stack Event Container Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=portainer:stack container_count=*
| stats sum(container_count) as total_value, avg(container_count) as avg_value by stack_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks stack values by total and average container count across Portainer stack event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `container_count` values for each Portainer stack event event and review total and average container count by stack.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total container count.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you which stack shows the biggest container count numbers in your Portainer stack event data.
